start: HQ in Google mode, not signed in, asking a gym page

user_sees: Back on the page asked for, signed in
must_not: The sign-in not written in HQ's log

steps.action: Open HQ and pass Cloudflare Access with the allowed account
Sign in with a Google account that is not allowed
user_sees: 'Could not sign you in' with 'This Google account cannot open MettleUp HQ.' and 'Try again'
must_not: Any HQ page for that account

steps.action: Sign in while the gym server is down
user_sees: 'Could not sign you in' with 'The gym server did not answer, so the sign-in could not be written down. Try again in a minute.'
must_not: A sign-in with no record in HQ's log

steps.action: A setting of HQ is missing
user_sees: 'MettleUp HQ is not set up yet' with 'A setting is missing. Ask Claude to check the HQ setup list.'
'Signed out' with 'You are signed out of MettleUp HQ.' and 'Sign in again'
must_not: HQ pages still open on this browser

steps.action: Open a support access action 20 minutes after sign-in
user_sees: The fresh sign-in words and 'Sign in again'
must_not: Support access opened with a sign-in older than 15 minutes
A session older than 30 days still working

user_sees: The sign-in is in HQ's log with whether it was fresh
must_not: Another person able to open HQ with a link from the history
